_comment: Hy4-preview prefill. The layout is TP32 / DP1 (tp32: the SC1 placement of #65884, one engine on the 8x4 Galaxy
mesh, every weight sharded once over 32 chips; hidden over the 4-chip axis 1 = PREFILL_TP, heads and sequence over
the 8-chip axis 0 = PREFILL_SP). The shared prefill stack cannot run it yet, so this manifest fails at
runner start naming the blocking issues (tt/hy4/layout.py TP32_BLOCKERS).
DEV / NUMERICS layout, for per-layer PCC bring-up only: PREFILL_HY4_LAYOUT=glm_prefill_sp8_tp4 PREFILL_SP=8
PREFILL_TP=4 PREFILL_SP_AXIS=0 (GLM-5.3's SP 8 x TP 4, 16 heads per chip, attention replicated over 8 rows).
PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE=4096 in every layout: the KV cache stripes 128-token blocks over 32 chips and the prefill
chunk writes chunk / 32 tokens per chip (tt/hy4/kv_cache.py, #65886).
